headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 18, 2026**
article:
The Boston Red Sox dominated the Tampa Bay Rays, securing a 10-0 shutout victory. Carlos Narváez led the Red Sox offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance. In another game, the Los Angeles Dodgers edged out the New York Yankees 2-1, with Max Muncy hitting a crucial home run. The Atlanta Braves also secured a convincing 15-1 victory over the Texas Rangers, with Chris Sale earning the win.

Several players have been placed on the injured list, impacting their teams' lineups. Lourdes Gurriel Jr. has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right adductor strain. Jeff Criswell, Sal Frelick, and Oneil Cruz have also been placed on the injured list due to various injuries. Additionally, Chris Bassitt, JoJo Romero, Brent Rooker, and Brice Matthews have been transferred to the 60-day injured list.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place. The Baltimore Orioles acquired Rudy Martin Jr. from the Kansas City Royals for cash. The St. Louis Cardinals traded for Trey Pooser from the Tampa Bay Rays. The Pittsburgh Pirates acquired Robert Hassell III from the Washington Nationals for cash. The Milwaukee Brewers traded for Lance McCullers Jr. and Colton Gordon from the Houston Astros.

top_news.title: **Rays Suffer Shutout Loss to Red Sox**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox dominated the Tampa Bay Rays 10-0, handing them their latest defeat. Carlos Narváez led the Red Sox offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Rays Fall to Red Sox in 3-5 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox secured a 3-5 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays, handing the Rays their loss. Wilyer Abreu led the Rays' offense with 2 hits, 2 home runs, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Take Down Yankees in Thrilling 2-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers edged out the New York Yankees 2-1, with Max Muncy leading the charge at the plate. Muncy hit a crucial home run (18) on a fly ball to right field, scoring Mookie Betts in the process.

top_news.title: **Braves Rout Rangers 15-1**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves dominated the Texas Rangers, securing a 15-1 victory. Drake Baldwin led the Rangers with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 5 RBIs, while Chris Sale earned the win for the Braves with 7 strong innings, striking out 6 and allowing 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Cruise Past Guardians 7-1**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Bryan Reynolds and Brandon Lowe standing out among the impact hitters. Jared Jones and Gavin Williams led the way for the Pirates' pitching staff.

top_news.title: **Gurriel Jr. Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Arizona Diamondbacks left fielder Lourdes Gurriel Jr. has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right adductor strain.

top_news.title: **Rudy Martin Jr. Traded to Orioles**
top_news.summary: Rudy Martin Jr. has been traded to the Baltimore Orioles in a deal that sent cash to the Kansas City Royals. The trade marks a new chapter for the outfielder in the American League East.
